enforcement_paths.behavior: Validates per-group maximum_attempts is 1 or 2, with no release-wide budget identity or registry reference.
_attempt_dir scans only reports/releases/v0.9.0/attempts beneath the supplied root and selects the first free attempt-01/attempt-02 directory. A fresh root is empty and starts at attempt-01.

run_group validates and allocates locally, writes started/completed receipts and appends the local ledger. A crash after started.json but before completed/ledger leaves a local started-only directory; the local allocator can skip it and choose attempt-02 if called again directly.

The serial orchestrator reads only the selected root ledger and rejects a started directory without completed.json. This review gate is not in the recorder allocator and can be bypassed by invoking the per-group launcher directly.
Control freshness/allocation also inspect only the supplied root. It uses a fixed local attempt-01 and rejects a repeated attempt only when that directory is already present in that same root.
run_control allocates locally, writes started.json before running, then writes terminal receipt and appends a root-local ledger. A lost started-only state cannot inform another root.

Launch gate requires the supplied root to equal the current contract designated root and checks retained-byte/resource budgets. It does not reconcile attempts for the operation across prior roots or contract revisions.
Control entry point shares the serial host lock and launch gate, then calls the root-local control allocator; serialization is not cumulative accounting.

demonstrated_root_reset.lost_run_root_evidence: The recovered completion row names execution_root /private/tmp/dfb-v090-controls-01/probe-bifrost-sanitizer-lowering and attempt_id probe-bifrost-sanitizer-lowering-attempt-01. Per-control roots are distinct, so attempt numbering is scoped separately to each directory.
demonstrated_root_reset.second_root_behavior: For a logical operation absent from reports/releases/v0.9.0/control-attempts/<control_id> in a newly designated root, _allocate_attempt creates attempt-01 again. For a matrix group, _attempt_dir likewise creates attempt-01 in an empty designated root. The allocator receives no prior-root ledger or immutable release-wide sequence.
demonstrated_root_reset.qualification: Code-path demonstration; the recovered second root was not executed as part of this read-only review.

unknown_prior_attempt_behavior.same_root_matrix_group: A retained attempt-01 directory consumes that local name even with no completed receipt. _attempt_dir can then allocate attempt-02 when invoked directly. The orchestrator rejects started-without-completion only if its completion preflight is used.
unknown_prior_attempt_behavior.same_root_control: A nonempty control attempt directory fails require_fresh validation, so another local control launch is blocked in that root.
unknown_prior_attempt_behavior.different_root_for_either_kind: No lookup reaches prior-root started receipts or missing ledgers. Unknown prior allocation is therefore not discovered; a new designated root can restart numbering.
unknown_prior_attempt_behavior.lost_run: For the seven lost transcript completions, charge one each. For the eighth Java launcher, allocation is unknown; charge one and do not treat the failed replay as proof that the historical allocation did not happen.

smallest_safe_implementation_integration.scope: Separate new versioned launchers and recorder modules, sharing one durable release-scoped allocator; preserve the original v0.9.0 launchers and receipt history.
integration_points: New versioned matrix-group recorder immediately before allocation
New versioned control recorder immediately before allocation
New versioned group and control entry points before dispatch; exact paths/version identifiers are owned by the implementation worker
smallest_safe_implementation_integration.mechanism: Bind the durable registry to the exact release, parent-plan/population identity, inventory identity, operation kind and exact operation ID. Atomically reserve and fsync a monotonically increasing slot under a shared interprocess lock before launch; keep the started reservation if terminal persistence is lost. Missing, malformed, contradictory, or started-only entries fail closed. A fresh execution root does not reset the registry.
smallest_safe_implementation_integration.concurrency: Reservation is atomic in the shared allocator; the analyzer serial lock alone is not cumulative accounting.
